title: Clicking a field in the email pop-up no longer makes the email jump

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-17: every time I click a new field on the email pop-up the screen blinks (Admin CRM Marketing, New email)

detail: Clicking a text slot on the email canvas selects its block, which closes one settings tile in the left block list and opens another. The pop-up's center pane scrolls, and browser scroll anchoring picked its anchor inside that list, so scrollTop moved by the tile height change and the whole canvas snapped up or down on a field click. Reproduced in Chromium against the canvas arrangement on a node document (render_path_email is on in prod): the clicked field moved 75px at 1280 and 1440 wide. Fix: the block list opts out of anchor selection ([overflow-anchor:none]), so the anchor lands on the canvas, which does not move. Measured after: 0px at 1440, 1280 and 900 (the stacked layout keeps its compensation because the canvas is still the anchor). Covers every pop-up that mounts this editor: CRM Marketing New email, Space Marketing New email, Message Member.

verify.note: Fails on main: the Blocks and settings list takes part in scroll anchoring. Passes once it carries [overflow-anchor:none].
